scope: Inventory completeness reconciliation B:24assigned countries under maintained EIU Democracy Index2024 baseline(published2025),25full+46flawed democracies. National/chamber and regional/special-status universe first; no stream,EPG or rights validation.
conclusion: No complete-inventory certificate. Concrete omissions: six Indian upper-house chamber records; named special-status authority review sets for ten Indian Sixth Schedule councils and three Tokelauan Taupulega. Several local exclusions need accurate scope wording; local ordinance power is not equivalent to zero authority.
global_caveats: All24assigned countries addressed; absence of identified omission is not proof that no institution exists.
National names are a distinct inventory grain from whole legislatures, viewing channels or subnational jurisdictions.
No invented assemblies from territory names, executive offices or administrative subdivisions.
Committee rooms are service children, not separate legislatures.
No catalogue,master inventory,eligibility or rights changes made by this report.
